Trading cards have gone from a childhood hobby to a multi-billion dollar investment market.. mostly because of PSA. And their power over the industry is alarming. Because mistakes that might seem small end up costing collectors hundreds, thousands and occasionally millions of dollars. As a result, many are beginning to question the true intentions of PSA and if that little grade number they give is quietly destroying card collecting.
